name: ORB
rootCause: leveraged pool buyout + refund-before-sell reentrancy drains burnLP-depleted reserve. Lost: ~44.9-45 BNB (~$32,610.72)

descriptions.text: leveraged pool buyout + refund-before-sell reentrancy drains burnLP-depleted reserve. Lost: ~44.9-45 BNB (~$32,610.72)

Attackers exploited ORBToken’s receive() function (which auto-granted max allowance) and ORBCore’s whitelist tax exemption. The addPoolAndSell function lacked a reentrancy guard, enabling repeated tax-free sells. Combined with burnLP destroying large amounts of ORB in the LP and a subsequent sync() to manipulate reserves, the attacker extracted about $32,610.72.
